title: Uniqueness from circuit encoding
statement: Let $C_1$ and $C_2$ be directed acyclic Boolean circuits, each with gates in topological order and a valid output vertex, possibly with different numbers of inputs. If their encodings are equal, then they have the same number of inputs, the same ordered list of gates, and the same output vertex.
hypotheses_covered: The circuits may have different input counts
Both circuits satisfy the DAG circuit validity conditions
